title: ZZ Leiden earn DBL title
description: ZZ Leiden - Den Bosch 92-81 ZZ Leiden conquered DBL title. They held off Den Bosch in Game 4 of the title series to take the crown. The game was mostly controlled by ZZ Leiden. Den Bosch managed to win second period 29-22. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. ZZ Leiden shot the lights out from three sinking 13 long-distance shots on high 59.1 percentage. The game was dominated by American players. Guard Tajion Jones (194-1999, college: UNC Asheville) fired 27 points (perfect from downtown making all seven shots !!!) for the winners. Forward Brock Gardner (201-1997, college: Master's, agency: Players Group) chipped in 19 points and 5 rebounds. Gardner is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market.
